name: J/80 asymmetric spinnaker, full-scale flying shape

source.citation: Deparday J., Bot P., Hauville F., Augier B., Rabaud M. (2016). Full-scale flying shape measurement of offwind yacht sails with photogrammetry. Ocean Engineering 127, 135-143. Table 3.
source.method: photogrammetry of the set sail at full scale, sections along stripes at fractions of the luff and the leech
source.sail: J/80 asymmetric spinnaker on a bowsprit: SLU 12.18 m, SLE 9.65 m, SF 7.30 m (design, table 2)

definitions.h: the section's height: its stripe's fraction of the luff and of the leech, 0 the foot
definitions.camber: largest depth of the section over its chord
definitions.draft: where the largest depth lies, fraction of the chord from the luff
definitions.twist_deg: horizontal angle of the section's chord from the foot's, to leeward
definitions.entry_deg: angle between the luff tangent and the chord
